content.title: HCAT Q3 Deep Dive: Flat Revenue, Migration Flexibility, and Profitability Focus Shape Outlook
content.summary: Healthcare data analytics company Health Catalyst (NASDAQ:HCAT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $76.32 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $73.5 million was less impressive, coming in 1.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.06 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
